facts.fact: The World Bank's status report of August 2025 says, on its latest mission's findings and before verification, that the Integrated Revenue Management System for Local Authorities (GIR-CT) is operational at national level and interfaced with local systems in more than 100 large municipalities, which manage the whole local taxation chain in it; the report does not say where the system is held or how the municipalities reach it.
facts.system: GIR-CT (Integrated Revenue Management System for Local Authorities)

facts.fact: The World Bank reports GIR-CT operational in 'more than 100 large municipalities' as of August 2025, against a target of at least 100, a result not yet verified; it gives no total of municipalities.
facts.system: GIR-CT (Integrated Revenue Management System for Local Authorities)
